We need to find a template that matches the retrosynthetic step: target molecule is COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O. Reaction described: cycloaddition where two unsaturated parts combine to form a cyclic product, forming C-C bond, breaking C-O bond, losing ketone and C-C triple bonds functional groups. So forward reaction: starting materials have ketone and alkyne (C-C triple) which undergo cycloaddition to give product with new ring, losing those groups. In retrosynthesis, we need to break a C-C bond (the new sigma bond) and form a carbonyl and alkyne? Actually forward: cycloaddition of a ketone? Wait typical [2+2+1] maybe? But description: "ketones and C-C triple bonds functional groups are lost". So starting materials contain a ketone and an alkyne; after cycloaddition they become part of product, losing those groups. So in retrosynthesis, we need to break a C-C bond (the one formed) and generate a carbonyl (C=O) and an alkyne (C#C). Also a C-O bond is broken (the carbonyl oxygen maybe? Actually carbon-oxygen is broken). So forward: C-O bond broken, C-C formed, ketone and alkyne lost. So we need to search templates where functional_groups_broken includes "ketone" and "C-C triple bond". functional_groups_formed includes maybe "ring" but not needed. Bonds formed: C-C sigma. Bonds broken: C-O (maybe carbonyl C-O). Bonds order changed: carbonyl C=O to something else? Not sure.

We can use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with appropriate criteria. Let's try.


We will call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with molecule_smiles target, functional_groups_broken list includes "ketone", "C-C triple bond". bonds_formed ["C-C"] maybe need format "6-6"? Not sure. The tool expects bond types like "6-6". Might be atom types? Hard.

Simplify: just search with functional_groups_broken ["ketone", "C-C triple bond"] and limit 5.
